text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Thomson MO and TO series were a family of French 8-bit home computers developed during the 1980s for education, home use, and programming. Introduced through the French government's computing initiatives, Thomson computers became common in French schools and homes. The systems used the Motorola 6809 processor and featured advanced graphics and sound capabilities compared with many contemporary 8-bit computers. Popular models such as the MO5 and TO7 supported games, educational software, and applications through cassette tapes, cartridges, and disk drives.
